violations.text: Milk and almond milk were observed held between 44-45 degrees Fahrenheit in the 3-door lowboy. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. 3-door lowboy was observed fluctuating in temperature from 44-50 DF. All milk was moved to properly functioning refrigeration at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to store any TCS foods in 3-door lowboy until it is able to keep an internal food temperature of 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

Eggs are served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. Consumer advisory must be added to the menu. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

-3-door lowboy was observed fluctuating in temperature and in poor repair -The small 1 door reach-in was observed with an accumulation of ice build-up, establishment is to remove ice/run a defrost on unit. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the small ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the outside back area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 09/10/2026
